fields.description: Ledger used by the managed Excise + VAT templates. Leave blank if the company does not deal in excisable goods.
fields.label: Excise Duty Account

fields.description: Leave enabled when the company holds an excise licence, so excise posts to the Excise Duty Account. Disable it when there is no licence: the excise is then added to each item's rate and removed from Taxes and Charges, so it lands in the item's own income or expense account. The amount stays visible in Excise Duty on the invoice and on each item row.
fields.label: Record Excise in a Separate Account

fields.description: Applied to new Sales Invoices. Making a template the default clears the default flag on every other Sales tax template for this company.
fields.label: Default Sales Tax Template

fields.description: Applied to new Purchase Invoices. Making a template the default clears the default flag on every other Purchase tax template for this company.
fields.label: Default Purchase Tax Template

fields.description: Enable this if the company issues hand bills from a pre-printed bill book instead of an e-billing system. A 'Manual Invoice No' field appears on the Sales Invoice, and the number entered there becomes the invoice number used in the IRD registers and CBMS.
fields.label: Allow Manual Sales Invoice Number

fields.description: If enabled, a Sales Invoice that uses a manual invoice number cannot be submitted unless the hand bill is attached in the 'Attach Sales Invoice' field.
fields.label: Make Manual Bill Attachment Mandatory
